name: Auto Racing 3D
author: JohnProStudio
description:
Shift up, shift down, go around corners as fast you can to beat your opponent before time runs out...

-Play on 7 race tracks.
-Unlock and drive responsively in the city to find 10 photos scattered in the city.
-Beat your own records and compare your score worldwide.
-Online Multiplayer Now Available
-Play with your friends on the same device with a split-screen multiplayer mode.
-Split-screen multiplayer Drag Race Mode now available
-Unlock 19 cars, change colors, adjust the handling.

And more importantly, have fun responsibly.
